appearance_facts.fact: A large bold title spans the upper area, reading 'Declining Emergency Department Visits in Region Z from 2012 to 2023'. Below it is a smaller gray subtitle line.

A single solid dark-red line connects annual points from 2012 to 2023. The line starts low on the left, rises gradually to a mid-level, jumps sharply around 2018, stays flat, then rises steeply to a peak at 2022 before a small drop at 2023.
A vertical y-axis and horizontal x-axis frame the plot with faint horizontal gridlines at the labeled tick values.
